messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
For the work equipment listed in Annex VII of Legislative Decree 81/2008, who carries out the first periodic verification, and within what time?

response.text: Per le attrezzature di lavoro elencate nell'Allegato VII del Decreto Legislativo 81/2008, chi effettua la prima verifica periodica e entro quanto tempo?
